title: First joints
about: The three everyday joints: a twist block, a snap-on cover and a threaded grub joiner.

notes.text: The twist block: its four plugs are pushed into the block below and turned to lock.
The cover: it snaps onto the top of the twist block.
The grub joiner: a threaded pin, half in each of the two plain blocks. Choose this note to see it through them.

title: Frame
about: A closed frame: two posts on a base, and a bar across the top held by a joiner in each post.

notes.text: The posts are twist blocks, locked into the base.
A grub joiner is screwed into the top of each post.
The top bar lies across both joiners. Hold a bar near one of them and it takes both.

title: Frame corner
about: Three long twist blocks meeting in a corner cube, stiffened by two corner braces.

notes.text: The corner cube: a twist block locks into each of three of its faces.
A corner brace: it plugs into two arms at once and keeps them square.

title: Hinge
about: Two blocks joined by a hinge that swings.

notes.text: The hinge: with it selected, press the Swing buttons that appear beside the build.
The block on the hinge's free leaf swings with it, and so does the cover on that block.
